title: Mixed Event — The Tomorrow We Hope For — Episode2 Helping Out a Priestess?

meta.Event Outline: When Haruka stops by the shrine along her usual running route, she sees the shrine maiden who was there for her in her time of need collapse. In order to repay her for her kindness, Haruka decides to help out at the shrine in her stead.

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's decide what we're gonna do for our New Year's stream on the second!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's get started!
I brought lots and lots of ideas with me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku and the others mentioned that you did a rehearsal together for last year's stream.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We sure did. We all practiced playing Karuta and Fukuwarai together!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin said that Shizuku is really talented at Fukuwarai, so I'd love to see you all play.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you would?
Then, we might just have to play again.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I heard that your Karuta match turned into an exciting battle as well♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, it was Minori and Miku versus Airi and Rin.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I really didn't end up doing much that time... Airi and Miku pretty much got everything...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, it sounds like you girls had a blast. What do you plan on doing this time?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: About that! I think we should make our own mochi this year!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Make your own mochi?!
That sounds amazing♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hold on... Don't you need a mortar and mallet to make mochi? Where do we get those?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. Where, is a good question.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The garden at Shizuku's place would be perfect since it's pretty big, but we wouldn't want anybody figuring out where she lives so... I say we do something else.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But... Mochi!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
How about some calligraphy...?
We can do that indoors just fine.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I see. All we would have to do is bring over our calligraphy sets.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I know!
What if you give what you write to your fans as a little present?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's a great idea!
I wouldn't know what to do with myself if I won something like that...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, you have to make something too, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
R-Right!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Haha...
I never would've thought to give them out. Nice one, Miku. You really know what the fans want.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it is a good idea, but I still think playing Karuta would be really fun...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, why don't we play right now?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin, they're trying to have a serious meeting.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe...
No, she's right. It was very exciting last time, so I'm sure our fans will enjoy seeing it again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree! I want everybody to see just how good Airi is at Karuta♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Wanna do a quick rehearsal?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure. I'll be the reader to kick things off!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?! Yay!!
Thank you so much!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We should separate anyone who's played before so... How about Miku, Minori, Len and KAITO versus Rin, Haruka, Luka and MEIKO? Sorry, Shizuku, you'll have to sit out this one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's alright with me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. There's no way I'm losing to you, Len, since I played last time!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Correct me if I'm wrong, but I don't ever recall you actually winning after saying something like that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I can't wait to play.
This'll be my first time trying my hand at Karuta.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I actually really like these kinds of games. Let's both give it our best, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course! Idols are all about explosiveness! Nobody can match my reflexes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka's on the other team...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Good luck, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Have fun, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The cards are all set, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks! Then, let's get started!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: “The autumn rice paddies...”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Got it!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Already?! How?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That was so fast...!
I couldn't even see what you just did, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I just happened to remember that one, but I'm gonna get the next one too♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Is that so...?
I'll just have to put my serious face on then.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Th-There's no way I'm gonna get any now...!
New Year's Eve
Shrine Grounds

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Phew...
I ran a pretty good time this morning.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We got a good plan together for our New Year's stream yesterday, so I might just head home and relax now.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'll take some time to look back on this past year and come up with some resolutions for the new year.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Who's that hunched over there...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ms. Enomoto?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Are you okay?
Y-You look pale...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Please wait here! I'll head over to the shrine and find someone who can help!
Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: Thank you for being so kind.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It was nothing.
More importantly, how's Ms. Enomoto doing...?

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: She appears to be running a fever, so we're having her head home for the day...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A fever...? I didn't realize...

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden A
rows.Line: Is it true that Ms. Enomoto collapsed...?

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden B
rows.Line: What do we do? We're shorthanded this year as it is. We can't just replace her...

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: Quiet. We still have visitors on the grounds.

rows.Speaker: Shrine Maiden A
rows.Line: R-Right. I'm sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're shorthanded...?

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: Yes, we're always looking for help each year, but we're in some trouble this year... We have some part-timers and other extra hands helping out, but we can't replace someone like Enomoto...

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line: There's no way we'll be able to find anyone who can fill her shoes, so we have no choice but to try and persevere somehow...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Ms. Enomoto was looking forward to welcoming in the new year so much...)

rows.Speaker: Enomoto
rows.Line: As busy as it gets, I actually have a lot of fun seeing all these people stop by to pray and make their wishes.

rows.Speaker: Enomoto
rows.Line: They're all trying to make their futures as bright and prosperous as possible, so I'd like to help them achieve their goals in whatever way I can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is it possible for me to help out somehow...?

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! You can't make our shrine visit...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No. This shrine maiden I know came down with a fever and no one at the shrine seemed to know what they'd do without her, so I decided to volunteer...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As a result, I don't think I'll be able to make our shrine visit. I'm so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-It's okay, really!
I just thought it'd be nice if we could all go, but we can always go the next day if you're free!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That should work for us as well. Please, feel free to go and help.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all so much.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And who said chivalry's dead? I mean, look at you. It's like you're doing this because you owe her a huge debt.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, actually... This happened a long time ago, but she was there to support me when I really needed it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I felt so lost then, but she was willing to hear me out and even gave me words of encouragement. So in a way, I do owe her quite a bit...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll help too, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They're really shorthanded, right? I wanna help them too! If this shrine maiden really did help you, then I owe her a debt too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm sure you and your family already have plans. Also, I really am just volunteering since high schoolers technically aren't supposed to work at night...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's okay! My family always falls asleep before midnight!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Th-That's not what I'm trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, why don't I help out as well...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You too, Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii's going to be at Ichika's house for a sleepover, and I've actually been wondering what it's like to be a shrine maiden for a little while now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm with them. If it means helping out your shrine maiden friend and her shrine, why don't we all volunteer together?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'd even be able to go through with our visit like we planned once our shift's over. Think of it as two birds with one stone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you so much...
